members.name: Create Campaign
members.description: Provision Meta campaigns and ad sets on AdManage.ai from a declarative config. Runs on-demand — creates entities PAUSED, writes the returned IDs back into state so schedule-ads can launch into them.

members.name: Repo Revive
members.description: Pick the highest-★ dormant watched repo and make one targeted improvement to reactivate it — refresh stale model references, README, or metadata

members.name: Schedule Ads
members.description: Schedule paid ads across Meta/TikTok/Snapchat/Pinterest/LinkedIn via the AdManage.ai API, driven by a declarative config file. Launches PAUSED by default — never auto-activates live spend.

members.name: star-momentum-alert
members.description: Project the date a watched repo crosses its next star milestone — alert only when projected date lands inside the Show HN dispatch window (7-14 days out, Tue/Wed/Thu)
